programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Chinese buyers are spending more on lighter, trendier gold pieces
programme.desc: Gold jewelry consumption in China has seen a significant shift in recent times. Weight and high prices, once the prime market movers, are no longer the main drivers. Buyers are shifting to lighter pieces, while heritage craft and youth design are creating new reasons to buy.

programme.title: Inside the world’s first robot-staffed theme park
programme.desc: China has just opened what's billed as the world's first large-scale robot theme park in the southern city of Zhuhai – more than 300 humanoid robots working the floor. It's a debut for an industry that's raised billions but is still hunting for a commercial win.

programme.title: How tea factories are brewing new consumption
programme.desc: Who would travel to a factory just to watch tea being made? Turns out, quite a few people. In China’s tea producing county of Anxi, tea factories are opening their doors to tourists. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun sees how they are turning production lines into attractions, and visitors into potential customers.

programme.title: The little loofah that launched an industry
programme.desc: You've probably used one to scrub a pan. Maybe you've even worn one on your feet or found it hiding in a skincare product. But the loofah is far more than a bathroom staple. It is the backbone of an industry that spans provinces, employs thousands, and ships products around the world. What does its rise tell us about how rural areas in China is reinventing itself? On the show: Steve, Fei Fei & Yu Bokun.

programme.title: China-Germany Auto Cooperation
programme.desc: As Chinese new energy vehicles accelerate their global expansion, the auto industry is entering a new phase of competition and cooperation. How can technological innovation reshape the industry? And as Chinese automakers expand overseas, how should they move from exporting vehicles to building deeper local partnerships, supply chains and technology ecosystems? Join us on BizTalk, co-produced with World New Energy Vehicle Congress (WNEVC), as we explore the new trends shaping the global auto industry.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.desc: From China to France, America to India, and beyond - throughout human history, confectionery and desserts have united the world's shared sweet tooth, bringing hope and connection.

programme.title: Jingde 1, Anhui Province
programme.desc: In Anhui's Jingde county, the presenter uncovers the Huizhou-Confucian culture of ancestor worshipping in Jiangcun village's Mazu Temple and ancestral halls. Hiking in the hills shrouded by mist and rain, he meets Xuan ink-stone craftsmen who guide him to a long-lost quarry where he learns more about the area's legendary craftsmanship.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai's Yushu Prefecture is one of China's key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders' daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: In Search of Shunde Ep.2
programme.desc: A Bite of Shunde tells the stories of Shunde locals through food, showcasing this city's heritage and present-day life. It looks at the craftsmanship Shunde people apply in the kitchen and beyond, and the dedicated, artisan mentality behind their renowned culinary culture. Through their attitude toward a simple home-cooked meal, we get insights into their values and way of life.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He's heading out of Beijing proper, to the city's Miyun District. There he'll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: Clothing woven in the mountains
programme.desc: In Longsheng, southern China, ethnic communities have lived for generations among the same mountains and rivers. The landscape of terraced fields stretches across the valleys, carrying layered cultural memories. In this episode, CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipino singer Eliza Arce travel to Huangluo Yao Village. Beginning with the Red Yao tradition of sun-drying clothes, they explore the colours, craftsmanship, and everyday wisdom woven into these garments. Their journey culminates in a vibrant bonfire gathering, where different communities come together in celebration.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World"!

programme.title: Jingde 2, Anhui Province
programme.desc: Continuing the journey in Jingde, we visit ancient Hui-style houses in Zhuwang village, try health‑boosting lingzhi, observe the art of making seal ink paste, and learn about seal culture.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan's explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of "opening the gate", the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou's rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.desc: Seth parts ways with Alma and her helpers, and arrives at the continent of Cyfandir alone. There, he has an unexpected encounter with the Merchant Barons, who have come to this land to exploit its resources and see the sorcerer Seth as an enemy. Seth is backed into a corner by the Merchant Barons' fierce attacks, but finally escapes with Grimm's help. When Seth finally arrives in the city, he's surprised to see both sorcerers and ordinary humans living together... and admiring the Knights-sorcerers together.

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.desc: Seth runs into Melie and Doc, but Melie is cold toward him and quickly leaves. So Seth heads to the castle to look for clues about Radiant, but he's turned away at the gate. Then he encounters a myserious old man named Myr who leads him to the Knights-sorcerers' stables. There he meets an aspiring Knight-sorcerer named Ocoho, who's preparing to set out on a mission to defeat a Nemesis. Seth is mistaken for a newbie and taken along...

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.desc: When the battle threatens to ruin farmland, Seth does his best to protect the crops. Ocoho is impressed and casts defensive magic to help him, but she's reprimanded for going against orders. But then Queen Boudica appears and praises Ocoho for protecting the land as the legendary sorcerer Merlin did. The farmers also say that a spirit called the Dullahan started appearing in the area around the same time as the Spectral Nemesis...

programme.title: RADIANT
programme.desc: Seth visits Melie at the inn where she's staying, but she treats him coldly. Seth had left Artemis on his own because he didn't want to hurt his friends with the power he couldn't control, but Melie wanted Seth to have faith in her as his friend; the two of them just can't see eye to eye. Seth is left with nowhere to go, but then Ocoho asks him to train with her, offering to look in the castle library for information on Radiant in return. But Seth still isn't sure if he should be making new friends...

programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: Agent Game
programme.desc: (2022) Spy thriller starring Dermot Mulroney, Jason Isaacs and Mel Gibson. On the run after being blamed for a botched interrogation, can a CIA agent uncover the truth before it's game over?

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: (1979) All-star epic with Peter O'Toole and Burt Lancaster. Under orders to invade the Zulu nation, will Lord Chelmsford's men meet their match in the Battle of Isandlwana? Based on a true story.

programme.title: Johnson County War - Part 2
programme.desc: (2002) Contemporary western with Tom Berenger, Luke Perry and Burt Reynolds. Three brothers are pulled into a fiery conflict between old cowboys and new homesteaders. (2/2)

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: (1971) Comedy western with Lee Van Cleef and James Mason. It's a wild ride of bank robbing, wife swapping and double crossing as two rivals team up to steal a million bucks from the government.

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: (1967) Brutal western with Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law. Fifteen years after his family were massacred by bandits, a young boy is now a skilled gunslinger - and he's hell-bent on revenge...

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: (1948) Western starring Rod Cameron. A former Texas marshal is determined to prove a powerful casino owner is behind his brother's murder.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Treacherous
programme.desc: (2018) Thriller starring Emily Rose. While Annie is behind the wheel of her boyfriend's car, police discover a bloody knife in it. Now she needs to find out the truth before she's accused of murder...

programme.title: Time Of Death
programme.desc: (2013) Starring Kathleen Robertson. A top FBI agent is sent to crack a chilling case-key executives murdered at exactly 10:44 p.m. Can she stop the killer before the clock strikes again?

programme.title: Deadliest Switch
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller starring Lindsay Hartley. Two families are thrown into crisis when they discover their daughters were switched at birth - but nothing will stop one mother keeping what's hers...

programme.title: Gone Daughter Gone
programme.desc: (2020) Suspenseful thriller starring Andrea Bogart. When her daughter is abducted, Shannon decides to take matters into her own hands, putting her on a collision course with a deadly kidnapper...

programme.title: The Wrong Babysitter
programme.desc: A mother must revisit her husband's death in order to rescue her daughter who was kidnapped by her neighbour. Starring Daphne Zuniga (2017)

programme.title: Ex-Wife Killer
programme.desc: A woman vouches for her ex-husband after he seemingly kills his new wife in self-defence but after he is let off the hook, she discovers his elaborate ploy. Starring Marguerite Moreau (2017)

programme.title: ASSAULT ON PRECINCT 13
programme.desc: (1976) Cult classic from director John Carpenter. LA's deadliest gang just declared war on the cops - and for the unlucky few trapped inside Precinct 13, their night is about to become a nightmare...

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: (1978) A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: (1978) A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.desc: (1943) Drama based on a true story, starring Randolph Scott, Alan Curtis and Noah Berry Jr. In WWII, a rag tag band of soldiers try to take back vitally strategic territory.

programme.title: Chief of Station
programme.desc: (2024) Spy thriller starring Aaron Eckhart. Secrets stray too close to home for a former CIA European Station Chief when his wife's tragic death forces him to question everything he thought he knew...

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: (1972) Western with James Coburn and Telly Savalas. Branded a coward for surrendering his fort to the Confederates, a Union colonel recruits seven condemned men for a daring mission to recapture it.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: (1947) Western with the legendary John Wayne. A wounded gunslinger is taken in by a Quaker girl, who inspires him to give up his old ways - until his past catches up with him and puts her in danger.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: (1963) Western starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara and Patrick Wayne. A wealthy rancher must navigate warring factions in the Wild West while also fighting to save his troubled marriage.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Wish You Were Dead
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller with Emily Rose. Wishing for a better life for her and her daughter, a struggling mother makes a pact with two strangers who say they can 'eliminate' her problems.

programme.title: An Organized Killer
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller with Allison McAtee. Needing help with her full but chaotic life, Grace hires a live-in assistant. And once Lilith is invited in, there's nothing she won't do... to get what she wants.

programme.title: Killer Mom
programme.desc: At her father's funeral, Allison meets her birth mother who has a plan to stop her from inheriting $40-million. Starring Karen Cliché (2017)

programme.title: Dating to Kill
programme.desc: (2019) Cradle-robbing thriller with Clare Kramer. Jessica is shocked when her daughter starts dating an older man. But that soon turns to terror when she discovers her lethal connection to him...

programme.title: You Belong To Me
programme.desc: (2008) Supernatural scares with Shannon Elizabeth. After her divorce, Alex rejects Michael. But when his obsession turns dark, leading to tragedy, Alex must fight a supernatural force to save her son.

programme.title: Cruel Fixation
programme.desc: (2019) Tense thriller starring Kristina Klebe. A recently widowed woman grows suspicious of her insular son's new friend. Could his seemingly strange obsession with her turn sinister?

programme.desc: (1950) Drama starring Montgomery Clift and Paul Douglas. During the Berlin Blockade, two American sergeants smitten with German women struggle to navigate life and love.

programme.title: We Dive at Dawn
programme.desc: (1943) War drama starring John Mills. A WWII British submarine crew closes in on a deadly new German battleship. Just as they're ready to sink it, they run out of fuel.

programme.title: Firewalker

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: The Born Losers
programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: The Wild Angels

programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.desc: Hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Revealing the Origins of Life; Origins of the Solar System; Lice and Human Evolution; and a profile of neuroscientist Andre Fenton who studies how brains store and experience memories.

programme.title: scienceNOW: Can I Eat That?

programme.desc: Explore traits we once thought were uniquely ours- language, tool-making, even laughter- to uncover their evolutionary roots.

programme.sub-title: Can We Make it to Mars?

programme.title: scienceNOW: Can We Live Forever?
programme.desc: NOVA scienceNOW tackles the big question: can we live forever? Hosted by astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Can My Car Live Forever?; Body Shop - Body Parts; Can We Slow Aging?; and Hibernation.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Modern technology lets planes fly in tough weather, but it can cause an increase of air crashes. Extreme Weather tells of Julianne Koepcke's survival after lightning struck her Amazon flight. It covers Toronto's wind shear incident and Poland's fog crash.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Pilot error has caused many air crashes. The film examines incidents like the 1972 London and 2001 Queens crashes. Computer-controlled aircraft introduced new issues, seen in Qantas Flight 72's 2008 plunge and Air France Flight 447's 2009 disappearance.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Aircraft collisions are among the deadliest accidents.Despite millions spent on solutions, new issues arise. Key incidents and stories from survivors and a grieving father who took revenge after losing his family highlight why these problems persist.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Aircrash Confidental explores aviation's battle with engineering errors, from DC10 disasters to Jumbo Jet's explosion. Despite Boeing 747's safety, TWA Flight 800's 1996 explosion reveals risks. The industry learns, improving safety in modern aircraft.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Fire on Board details aviation's struggle with in-flight fires, like the 2007 China Airlines blaze, the 1985 Manchester fire and 1983 Air Canada Flight 797 disaster. The 1998 Swissair Flight 111 crash underscores persistent fire safety challenges.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidental
programme.desc: Terrorists target airliners, exploiting security gaps with bombs in drinks, shoes, and more. Air Crash Confidential explores this cat-and-mouse game with evolving threats and countermeasures like metal detectors, body scanners, and vigilant officers.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded: HURRICANES

programme.title: Destruction Decoded: CONSTRUCTION
programme.desc: Bridges and tunnels have transformed the way we live, making the inaccessible easy to reach, and turning time consuming journeys into convenient commutes, but when things go wrong they can go very wrong indeed.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded: MANMADE
programme.desc: When it comes to disasters, mother nature has mankind beat. However, as mankind expands, evolves and technology advances, it comes with dangerous challenges. When errors are made or unforeseen circumstances occur, the results can be devastating.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded: AIR, LAND AND SEA
programme.desc: Planes, trains and ships, our mass transit systems, have had a profound effect on mankind, making the world smaller and more connected.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded: TORNADO

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: It's wintertime in Portlandia. Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets. Candace's son (Bobby Moynihan) visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: In this Season 3 premiere, Spyke & Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens. A group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor. Sandra has a crush on a man in her meditation class.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland. A pedicab driver hustles for clients. Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The daylong event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects. Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate, Alexandra. A movie theater sells artisanal concessions. The consultants from "Japanese Toys, Cool Offices" get to work.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
